engine.boundary_note: All numbers are LOCAL runs on the official engine (PyPI wheel, vendored). No Kaggle online ladder games yet -- online metrics stay null until the team submits.

smoke_boot_runtime_seconds.method: wall clock of the final acceptance smoke_boot run (4 phases, 6 episodes: 24+96+96+720+48+48 steps)

eval_games_total.method: python workspace/software/scripts/run_eval.py --rounds 4 (2 contenders x 4 opponents x 4 seeds + 8 head-to-head)

eval_runtime_seconds.method: wall clock of the same eval run (excludes process startup)

avg_episode_runtime_seconds.method: mean of per-game elapsed_seconds across the 40 eval games

avg_turns_per_game.method: mean turns_played across the 40 eval games (full-length games)

submission_games_played.method: games involving the submission bot in the eval run

submission_win_rate_vs_pool.method: 16W-0L-0T vs {pass, random, starter, greedy_carrot}, 4 seeds each

submission_avg_final_money.method: mean of the submission bot's final reward across its 24 eval games (31160.19 vs pool, 29325.13 vs baseline_wheat head-to-head)

submission_avg_final_money_h2h.method: mean submission reward across the 8 head-to-head games vs baseline_wheat

baseline_wheat_avg_final_money_vs_submis.method: mean baseline_wheat reward across the same 8 head-to-head games

elo_ratings.method: EloTable k=32 start=1200 over the 40 recorded games, win/loss/tie only (official ladder semantics)

llm_ab_win_rate.note: LLM provider ships disabled (NullProvider) with a pluggable interface; no LLM-backed A/B games were run, so no number is claimed

online_ladder_games.note: no Kaggle submission made yet (team-side manual step per blueprint man-submit)
